dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Shrub is at risk due to behavior concerns. Shrub has demonstrated on-leash reactivity and has been reported to pull hard enough to choke himself and has required a harness for safer management. When seeing dogs, Shrub will fixate, become tense, pull strongly toward them, and vocalize loudly, and has difficulty being redirected. He has also displayed mouthy and jumpy behavior during leash placement, including attempting to mouth the leash and handler's hand. Shrub is noted to be social with handler, seeking attention and allowing petting. Medically, Shrub is noted to have Vomit/diarrhea episode.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!
dog.name: Shrub
